query: Make a security overview PDF of our site for the security team.
files: A web app repo with an app-level WAF, rate limits, IP auto-blocking, 2FA and CI
expected_behavior: Every printed number has an evidence row whose path:line points at the code that enforces it, and check-evidence.mjs ends at 0 problems
Rate limits, block thresholds and windows match the code exactly, without rounding
Firewall rules are named in words, with no payloads, regexes or URLs in the PDF
The PDF holds only the title, headings, tables, rows and Known limits, with no summary or footnotes
No section is split across pages and every page image was checked after the last render

query: Our pentest starts next week. Put together what protections we have so the testers know our limits.
files: A monorepo product with no WAF, auth library defaults, Docker isolation and no public domain
expected_behavior: Triggers the skill even though the user never says PDF or report
Titles the report with the product name when the repo has no domain
Drops firewall, IP block and probe sections instead of padding them
Counts library defaults only where the app uses them, citing the app call site
Lists missing two-factor, missing dependency audit or similar absences under Known limits with Not found evidence

query: What security headers and rate limits do we have? Need a doc for the security team.
files: A static site served by nginx with limit_req, headers set in nginx.conf, and a Cloudflare proxy configured only in the dashboard
expected_behavior: Reads limits and headers from nginx.conf rather than app code
States that Cloudflare dashboard rules cannot be proved from the repo, leaves them out of the PDF and tells the user
Adds a Known limit when protection depends on dashboard settings
Prints header effects in words, with header names in plain text
Keeps internal hostnames and server paths out of the PDF
